summary: Summarizes requirements for gateways on networks that use the DARPA Internet protocols. Though aimed at National Science Foundation research programs, it gives vendors general guidance, listing the protocols gateways must support and the documents that describe them. It was a draft and was replaced by RFC 1009.

eli5.summary: It is a checklist for companies building the machines that connect networks together, saying what rules those machines must know.

questions: what are the requirements for internet gateways
what protocols must a gateway support
